choices.text: [TODO:ar] Meet his eyes with quiet thanks

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Meet his eyes with quiet thanks

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse the bitter wine they offer

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Drink to dull the pain to come

[TODO:ar] Love refuses the easier path.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You shake your head and rise.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Refuse the bitter wine they offer
choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] You walk to the wood waiting.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Cry out a curse upon them

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Plead one last time for freedom

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] The soldiers fall silent below.

plead_free_consequence.title: [TODO:ar] The Work Is Being Done

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Your voice carries down the hill.

choices.feedback: [TODO:ar] Answer hatred with grace.
[TODO:ar] A penitent heart deserves answer.
[TODO:ar] Paradise opens for the broken.

choices.text: [TODO:ar] Curse the day you were born
